about: Step content that is neither data nor route, anchored on a quest's goal: a step's tip (tip), a level gate before the goal (level), or an objective kept off the "on the way" lists the route walks past (along: false; goal objective). at: { quest, goal: accept | turnin | complete | objective, objective? }. forge-writer applies each record to the guides it writes, every build; forge data check-corrections checks this file. A record with faction (Alliance or Horde) holds for that side's routes only. Each record has a note, its source ({ kind, ref }) and its issue or pr.

fixes.tip: Gordo, the big abomination, walks the road from here east past Cold Hearth Manor almost to Brill, and back: if he isn't at the arrow, follow the road east until you meet him. The Gloom Weed grows along the road around him.
fixes.note: Gordo's Task: Gordo walks the road, so a player can stand where the arrow points and not see him.

fixes.tip: Gordo walks the long road west of Brill, past Cold Hearth Manor, and back: the arrow follows his road west until you meet him.
fixes.note: Patience, Gordo's report: says that the arrow follows his road (the place 674-tirisfal-gordo-road).

Fields of Grief: the Tirisfal Pumpkins grow in the Scarlet-held fields off the road west of Brill (180 yards or more from Deathguard Simmer, 280 from Gordo), so a player on the Gloom Weed walk does not pass them; they stay at the step in the fields.
